mission: Build an end-to-end tech essay writer skill with multi-agent adversarial architecture, external perspective review, intake system for links/docs/code, and publish-ready output for company internal and public posting to increase personal influence. Reference gstack multi-agent patterns. Run 50 sprints.

sprints.direction: Install skill to ~/.claude/skills/tech-essay-writer (symlink or copy SKILL.md + scripts/ + prompts/ + templates/) and add bilingual Chinese/English support across all agent prompts and output formats
sprints.summary: Bilingual Chinese/English support across all 11 agent prompts + orchestrator + pipeline state. Chinese platforms: 微信公众号, 知乎, 掘金, CSDN.

sprints.direction: Add platform-specific format adapters for Medium, dev.to, WeChat公众号, 掘金, Hashnode — each with correct frontmatter, image handling, and platform-specific formatting rules

Build a personal branding engine: author profile system (bio, expertise areas, writing voice), social media package enhancement (Twitter/X thread, LinkedIn post, 小红书 post, HN title), and author expertise graph that tracks topic authority across articles

Add two new review panel agents: 1) External Perspective agent (fresh-eyes reader who catches assumptions, unexplained jargon, missing context — represents someone who has NEVER seen this topic before) 2) Fact-Checking agent (verifies technical claims against docs, detects outdated API references, validates code examples are correct)

Add outline adversarial critique: after 3 outlines are generated, dispatch an agent that reads all 3 and critiques each one, finding structural weaknesses and recommending the strongest. Also add review panel calibration — inter-reviewer consistency check that normalizes scoring and detects reviewer blind spots

Build an influence scoring system that predicts article's influence potential (topic novelty, author expertise match, SEO factors, social shareability, audience size) and an SEO metadata generator (OpenGraph tags, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, structured data, keyword density analysis)

Add new article templates (comparison, listicle, incident postmortem, release announcement, architecture decision record) and build a code example validation system that parses code blocks, checks syntax, verifies imports, and flags non-runnable examples

Build diagram and image suggestion engine — analyze article content and suggest where architecture diagrams, flow charts, comparison tables, or screenshots would improve comprehension. Output suggested diagram descriptions in Mermaid syntax where possible

Build article series support (multi-article series with consistent narrative arc, cross-references, series metadata, and reading order) and analytics feedback loop (track article performance metrics like views/shares/comments, feed metrics back into taste memory to improve future articles)

Build a configuration system — user preferences for default target platforms, preferred writing style, target audiences, language preferences, default author profile. Store at ~/.tech-essay-writer/config.json with CLI commands to get/set values

Build progress visualization system (show pipeline progress to user with stage indicators, completion percentage, quality metrics dashboard) and publishing workflow guides (step-by-step instructions for publishing to each supported platform with platform-specific SEO tips)

sprint_summary: Bilingual Chinese/English support added across the entire pipeline. Language directive injected into all 7 prompt builders in orchestrate.sh via build_language_directive() helper. All 11 agent prompts updated with Language sections including Chinese platform guidance. SKILL.md updated with language detection at intake stage. Symlink was already installed. All 136 tests pass.
